title: A Extraction for the Cipher
author: I. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Mirabel Joubert, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
